datasets.name: DepMap 24Q2 Public
datasets.description: Broad DepMap public CRISPR dependency and expression release used to rank noncanonical vulnerabilities in high-risk B-ALL.

datasets.name: DFCI 16-001 Pediatric ALL RNA-seq Cohort (GSE181157)
datasets.description: Primary-patient pediatric ALL RNA-seq cohort with molecular subtype calls used to integrate subtype expression into the B-ALL target-prioritization analysis.

datasets.name: Paired Diagnosis/Relapse Pediatric B-ALL Cohort (GSE28460)
datasets.description: Paired diagnosis-versus-relapse pediatric B-precursor ALL expression cohort used to measure relapse-direction support in the B-ALL integration study.

datasets.name: PRISM Repurposing Public 23Q2
datasets.description: Broad PRISM repurposing screen release used for exploratory pharmacology in B-ALL, including trimetrexate activity in annotated B-ALL lines.

datasets.name: World Development Indicators
datasets.description: World Bank country panel used to compare fixed telephony, mobile subscriptions, fixed broadband, and internet use across communications-policy peer countries.

datasets.name: OpenNeuro ds005398
datasets.description: Open pediatric-dominant iEEG epilepsy surgery dataset with derivative HFO event tables used for pathology-conditional outcome modeling.

datasets.name: National Survey of Children's Health
datasets.description: Annual U.S. child health survey public-use files pooled across 2016-2024 to study smoking exposure and functional burden in pediatric epilepsy.

datasets.name: TCGA Lower Grade Glioma and Glioblastoma Cohort via cBioPortal (lgggbm_tcga_pub)
datasets.description: Merged TCGA glioma cohort accessed through cBioPortal and filtered to IDH-wildtype glioblastoma cases for the MGMT-by-age survival interaction analysis.
